info.title: API.SH: bol
info.description: The bol API from API.SH: public bol data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

parameters.description: true to include products that are not available right now.

parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

Every seller's offer for one bol product in one condition: seller (id, name, rating), price, list price, unit price, delivery promise and date, shipping cost, deals and loyalty points. `total` is the shop's count of offers in that condition; `has_more` is true when the shop lists more than this first page.

One bol product: title, brand, authors / publishers for books, description, all images, categories with ids, every specification group (ingredients, nutrition, dimensions, technical data...), highlights, warnings, energy label, sustainability evidence, warranty, the best offer and the cheapest / fastest new and cheapest second-hand offers with seller, price, list price, unit price, delivery and deals, the number of offers, the review summary (average, distribution, AI topic summaries with sentiment counts) and the first reviews.

get.description:
bol (bol.com, Netherlands and Belgium) product search with every filter the shop offers: product id, link, title, brand, rating and review count, the best offer (seller, price, list price, unit price, delivery promise and date, shipping cost, deals, loyalty points), the cheapest new and second-hand offers, category paths, highlights, sustainability verdict, sponsored flag, image and description. `facets` lists the categories, brands and every other filter for the query with their value ids (pass them in `filters`), plus the price range. The shop shows up to `max_page` pages (often 10). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bol-search

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: relevance (default), popularity, price_asc, price_desc, rating, newest, wishlist.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Facet value ids from `facets`, comma-separated (e.g. 4288800517 for the brand Douwe Egberts, 58334 for deals only).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Only this category (an id from the category facet, e.g. 20598).

parameters.name: include_unavailable
parameters.description: true to include products that are not available right now.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
